mentions.h: from the Belgravian ... 25 years ago ... and 40 years ago

mentions.note: joined September 1930; first AAA vest and England colours 1936; 3rd AAA 10 Miles 1936; won Surrey 6 miles track, Southern Counties 6 Miles, Inter Counties, British Workers National; won Southern Cross-Country Championship 1946

photos.c: Above: Tom and his trophies, circa 1936
